source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
When this unit is picked to shoot in your [Shooting Phase](vsdata:core-rule/shooting-phase), you may pay 1 [Pain token](vsdata:ability/drukhari.power-from-pain) to make it Empowered.

While it is Empowered, once this unit has shot, pick 1 enemy unit that took at least 1 hit from those attacks. That unit cannot claim the **[Benefit of Cover](vsdata:core-rule/benefit-of-cover)** until the end of the phase.
